title: Assessing the environmental footprint of electrochromic windows: a comparative LCA with AI-based forecasting
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00638D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mohsen Rabbani, Olivia Tahti, Sabinus Essel Arthur, Macy A. Hopping, Christopher J. Barile, Mohd Hassan Karim, Ario Fahimi, Ehsan Vahidi
Electrochromic windows exhibit 35% lower carbon emissions than conventional double-pane windows. Coupling LCA with AI-based forecasting (ANN and ANFIS) reveals that electricity use and frame design are the primary environmental hotspots.
